package dependencies

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	runtime "retrom/internal/adapter/runtime/dependencies"
	"retrom/internal/capability/format/arcadedat"
	model "retrom/internal/model/dependencies"
)

const captureValidDAT = "<datafile><game name=\"demo\"><rom name=\"demo.bin\" size=\"1\" crc=\"12345678\"/></game></datafile>"

type captureCase struct {
	Name string
	Contents string
	Missing, Cancel, WriteFailure bool
	Core string
	Expected model.CatalogStats
	Indexed int64
}

type captureTree struct {
	Type string
	Text string
	Children []captureTree
}

type captureObservation struct {
	Name string
	Catalog arcadedat.Catalog
	Error *captureTree
	Events []string
	Code string
	Canceled, Missing, WriteCause bool
}

type captureRepository struct {
	model.Repository
	model.CatalogRecords
	model.JobRecords
	events []string
	code string
	failure error
}

func (repository *captureRepository) WithWrite(ctx context.Context, work func(model.WriteScope) error) error {
	repository.events = append(repository.events, "transaction")
	if repository.failure != nil {
		return repository.failure
	}
	return work(model.WriteScope{Catalog: repository, Jobs: repository})
}

func (repository *captureRepository) MarkFailed(context.Context, string, int64) error {
	repository.events = append(repository.events, "mark-failed")
	return nil
}

func (repository *captureRepository) Finish(_ context.Context, finish model.JobFinish) error {
	repository.events = append(repository.events, "finish")
	repository.code = finish.Code
	return nil
}

func captureError(err error, root string) *captureTree {
	if err == nil { return nil }
	result := &captureTree{Type: fmt.Sprintf("%T", err), Text: strings.ReplaceAll(err.Error(), root, "<ROOT>")}
	switch cause := err.(type) {
	case interface{ Unwrap() []error }:
		for _, child := range cause.Unwrap() {
			result.Children = append(result.Children, *captureError(child, root))
		}
	case interface{ Unwrap() error }:
		if child := cause.Unwrap(); child != nil {
			result.Children = append(result.Children, *captureError(child, root))
		}
	}
	return result
}

func TestCaptureCatalogBaseline(t *testing.T) {
	expected := model.CatalogStats{MachineCount: 1, ROMEntryCount: 1}
	cases := []captureCase{
		{Name: "valid", Contents: captureValidDAT, Expected: expected},
		{Name: "indexed-shortcut-missing", Missing: true, Expected: expected, Indexed: 1},
		{Name: "open-missing", Missing: true, Expected: expected},
		{Name: "open-missing-write-failed", Missing: true, WriteFailure: true, Expected: expected},
		{Name: "canceled-open-missing", Missing: true, Cancel: true, Expected: expected},
		{Name: "statistics-mismatch", Contents: captureValidDAT, Expected: model.CatalogStats{MachineCount: 2}},
		{Name: "statistics-mismatch-write-failed", Contents: captureValidDAT, Expected: model.CatalogStats{MachineCount: 2}, WriteFailure: true},
		{Name: "invalid-xml", Contents: "<datafile><game></datafile>", Expected: expected},
		{Name: "invalid-xml-write-failed", Contents: "<datafile><game></datafile>", Expected: expected, WriteFailure: true},
		{Name: "empty-dat", Contents: "", Expected: expected},
		{Name: "canceled-valid", Contents: captureValidDAT, Cancel: true, Expected: expected},
		{Name: "canceled-valid-write-failed", Contents: captureValidDAT, Cancel: true, WriteFailure: true, Expected: expected},
		{Name: "unsupported-core", Contents: captureValidDAT, Core: "unsupported", Expected: expected},
	}
	observations := make([]captureObservation, 0, len(cases))
	for _, testCase := range cases {
		observations = append(observations, captureOne(t, testCase))
	}
	contents, err := json.MarshalIndent(observations, "", "  ")
	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	if err := os.WriteFile("old-go-observations.json", append(contents, '\n'), 0o600); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	t.Logf("captured %d original loadCatalog observations", len(observations))
}

func captureOne(t *testing.T, testCase captureCase) captureObservation {
	t.Helper()
	root := t.TempDir()
	if !testCase.Missing {
		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, "fixture.dat"), []byte(testCase.Contents), 0o600); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(t.Context())
	defer cancel()
	if testCase.Cancel { cancel() }
	repository := &captureRepository{}
	writeFailure := errors.New("DAT failure record unavailable")
	if testCase.WriteFailure { repository.failure = writeFailure }
	core := testCase.Core
	if core == "" { core = "fbneo" }
	bootstrap := catalogBootstrap{ctx: ctx, repository: repository, now: time.UnixMilli(1000)}
	catalog, err := bootstrap.loadCatalog(&runtime.Version{DATRoot: root}, core, "fixture.dat", testCase.Expected, testCase.Indexed, "dat", "job")
	return captureObservation{
		Name: testCase.Name, Catalog: catalog, Error: captureError(err, root),
		Events: repository.events, Code: repository.code,
		Canceled: errors.Is(err, context.Canceled), Missing: errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist), WriteCause: errors.Is(err, writeFailure),
	}
}
